test_inference_dropout_retained: test that retain_dropout=True enables dropout during inference for encoder and decoder modules
test_inference_dropout_default_false: test that dropout is disabled during inference by default when retain_dropout is not set
test_training_mode_toggle: test that calling eval on the transformer model disables training mode on all dropout modules
test_retain_dropout_modules_filter: test that retain_dropout_modules list selectively enables inference dropout only for specified module types
build_transformer_model_with_dropout: build a TransformerModel with retain_dropout enabled and verify dropout modules apply during inference
